label: Ruijie Reyee RG-NBS3100-8GT2SFP-P-V2
description: Ruijie Reyee RG-NBS3100-8GT2SFP-P-V2 - 10-port Layer 2 cloud-managed PoE switch: 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 all PoE/PoE+ (IEEE 802.3af/at, 125 W budget) and 2x 1GE SFP uplinks. 20 Gbps switching capacity, 14.88 Mpps, fanless, 11 W with no PoE load and 145 W at a full 125 W PoE load.

poe.note: Datasheet: 'PoE Out standard - PoE/PoE+ (IEEE 802.3af/at)', 'PoE budget - 125 W'.

notes: Datasheet: 'Number of PoE Out ports 8' - every copper port sources power, there is no non-PoE access port to park a non-powered device on for free. 'Number of PoE/PoE+/PoE++ Out ports No', so no 802.3bt. 'Maximum power consumption 11 W (with no PoE load) / 145 W (with full PoE load)' against a 125 W budget. 'Fanless design', 300 x 205 x 44 mm, 1.80 kg. Management is web/cloud only: the datasheet lists SSH 'No', with HTTP/HTTPS login, eWeb, SNMPv1/v2c/v3 and Ruijie Cloud / Reyee App. Layer 2 only - 'IPv4 static route No', 'DHCP server No'; 4094 VLANs, 8000 MAC address entries, 9216-byte jumbo frames. Port names ge1..ge8 / sfp1..sfp2 are the catalogue's naming convention for a web-managed access switch; the datasheet states port counts (8 RJ45, 2 optical), not names.
